messages:
Miriam: quick standup — SDKs/quickstarts/docs
Miriam: yesterday: landed the Python SDK retry fix (thanks @Josh for the review) and started a draft for the node quickstart
Miriam: blockers: sample-app e2e is flaking on CI, unclear if it's a test timing or a real regression
Miriam: today: triage the e2e, finish node quickstart draft, open PR for the docs snippet

Josh: saw the CI flakes, I can look at the failing test tonight, might be the mock server timeout
Josh: pinged @ci-bot to rerun the suite for the last commit

Li: docs update: found two typos in the node quickstart and one broken link to the model catalog — will push a patch
Li: also added a note about env var names (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs API_KEY) per @Sam's question from yesterday

Sam: sample app status: repro locally once with the memory leak when running >1000 messages in conversation simulation
Sam: workaround: restart worker every 10k msgs, but that's not acceptable for production — assigning myself to look into the client KV cache usage

Eva: small UX ask: can we include code snippet for streaming responses in quickstart? customers keep asking
Eva: I can draft it if someone drops a short example of the streaming callback in TS

docs-bot: new PR created by Li: refs/PR #412 — fix(node-quickstart): typos + model catalog link
docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #412

ci-bot: rerun triggered by Josh on commit 1a2b3c — run started
ci-bot: failing test: samples/e2e/conversation.test.js (timeout after 30s) — investigating

Miriam: thanks all — next steps:
Miriam: - @Josh & @Sam pair on the e2e repro and root cause
Miriam: - @Li to merge docs fixes once green
Miriam: - @Eva to add streaming snippet; @Miriam will review
Miriam: drop PR links here when ready, and if anyone needs me to unblock infra for debugging, ping me directly :thumbsup:
